headline: Rushoar stone breaker
title: Rushoar | Early Mount That Smashes Stone | Palworld Guide
video_script: Slow at breaking stone in Palworld one point zero? Rushoar is a small Ground Pal you can ride, and its partner skill, Hard Head, boosts how fast you destroy Stone by five hundred to two thousand percent while mounted. At base it works Mining level one, so it is a handy early helper. Will you ride Rushoar? Comment below!
description: Rushoar in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable Ground Pal that destroys Stone far faster with Hard Head.
